LAST EXIT

Danny Vance drove getaway cars until the night his partner left him in a ditch. Four years later he is out, his sister’s diner is drowning in someone else’s debt, and the man who owns that debt wants a driver. Eight chapters, played on the same highways, with their own cash.

Story cash$0Online wallet $0

You start on foot, on the shoulder of Route 1, a long highway loop through farmland, pine forest, mountains, a city and a harbor bridge. A second highway, Route 9, crosses it at two interchanges. To change roads, signal right, take the extra lane and follow the exit ramp; cars and police use the ramps too. Fourteen stores stand along the highways (gas stations, 24/7 marts, corner markets, pawn shops and gun stores): walk in, raise a gun at the clerk and keep it on them while they bag the register. Some clerks fight back, some trip the silent alarm. Gun stores sell eight guns: a pistol, a .44, pump and combat shotguns, an SMG, the assault rifle, a light machine gun and a scoped hunting rifle. Walk up to a car, yank the driver out and take it. Then drive: real traffic, mirrors, signals, cruise control and the same tunable car. Crimes only count if somebody sees them: speed, steal, shoot or crash in front of witnesses and the police come, with more stars for worse crimes. Lose them and the whole ledger pays out in cash. Get caught and you pay a fine. Cars you steal stay in your Garage, where you can also buy better ones with the cash. The Mod shop upgrades the engine, tires, brakes and armour, adds nitrous and spy gear, and repaints, stripes and re-wheels any car you own. Signed in to claude.ai, your cash, cars and parts are saved to your account. People stand and walk along the shoulder: hit one or shoot one and it is a serious crime if anyone is watching. You have a rifle.
